post.description: Persist command key (trusted principal, create-session, client_operation_id), canonical request hash and new Session in the SAME MySQL transaction. Same key/hash returns original Session (201 for initial creation, 200 for known duplicate); different hash returns 409 operation_conflict without mutation. Authorize first. Deleted Session is not recreated by duplicate POST; return 409 state_conflict and recover original command with GET. After unknown ACK or refresh clients GET session-creation-commands/{original operation_id}; never guess by title or automatically POST. Principal is never accepted from body.

post.description: Before mutation, max_model_calls must be integer 1..10000 and exactly 1 for chat. No implicit defaults. Invalid wire/Chat bound: 400 invalid_request. Installation may set a LOWER explicit cap; above that cap: 422 run_limit_exceeded. Never silently reduce the requested cap or truncate child_request_ids. Count stable unique child model attempts, including in-flight/unknown, against accepted limit before dispatch; restore reads keep the full list. Request count and money/token budgets remain the original kernel responsibility.

get.description: Read only using authenticated principal + create-session domain + original client_operation_id, without knowing session_id. No principal/owner/hash query override. 200 accepted returns original session_id and request hash. 404 not_found means no visible authoritative retained result: creation outcome remains unknown. 503 dependency_unavailable means read unavailable: outcome remains unknown. Neither response authorizes POST or a new operation ID. Retained tombstone may return 410 and requires manual recovery, never reuse the ID. Deleted original Sessions do not make this command create or select another Session.

RunLimits.description: Explicit requested caps intersect with installation policy; no implicit production defaults. Money scale=9. max_duration includes approval and recovery wall time.

ModelCallResult.description: Internal typed ModelClient result only, not a public inference response or proof. Consumer MUST read original child terminal/authority through the trusted store before executing tools. No public caller may submit this object.

SessionEvent.description: Only durable committed events. seq is per-run decimal string; IDs/offsets and type/state consistency require semantic checks. No secrets or raw provider payload.

SessionCreationCommand.description: Durable create-session command result scoped by authenticated principal and create-session operation kind, never a caller supplied owner. accepted proves original creation committed; it does not prove the Session still exists. Original deleted ID remains unchanged.
